analyst.summary: Endurance Technologies posted record FY26 revenue growth (up 26%) across its India and European auto-component operations, but independent analysis flagged that margins came under pressure even as the top line grew strongly - a sign that rising input costs are eating into the benefit of that growth, similar to what peer auto-component makers have reported. The company continues to invest in EV-related electronics (battery management systems) alongside its traditional casting and braking business. Q1 FY27 results were not yet available at the time of this review. The stock's valuation is rich by historical auto-component standards, reflecting optimism about the EV transition that is not yet fully proven out in margins.
